audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for Week 14 mini design board presentation aligned exactly to the model board.
audio_prompts.script: This is my mini design board. The title is Soft Ocean Dress. This board shows a fashion sketch of a soft blue dress. The figure is standing in a front view. The figure is wearing a blue dress with short sleeves and a round neckline. I imagine this garment in a lightweight, flowy fabric. The main detail is floral embroidery near the neckline. This design is inspired by the ocean. I chose blue and white because they create a calm mood. The overall look is soft and elegant.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One adult teacher or Fashion Design classroom presenter speaking clearly to beginner learners.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Warm, clear, and easy to follow, with short pauses between each board section and slight emphasis on the title, the main detail, and the reason sentence.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an available OpenAI or ChatGPT voice at generation time that sounds like a supportive classroom teacher or studio presenter.
